description: List the tasks in a Microsoft To Do list. Returns compact task summaries (title, status, importance, due date, created/completed times, and a body preview). Optionally filter by status. Use to browse a user's to-do list and see what tasks or reminders it contains.

list_id.description: The ID of the Microsoft To Do task list to read (from list_task_lists).

status.description: Optional filter restricting results to tasks with this status.

top.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 50, max 100).

name: list_tasks
title: List Tasks
